sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:44

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:44:1
items.html:
Yesod as a whole is the discernment of front, and it has no posterior that descends from it: The meaning is that it was explained above that nothing was cancelled from AVI except the discernment of the posterior vessels, which is everything that reached them in the secret of an addition upon their own emanation — namely, the discernment of the coupling of Gadlut that emerged because of the descent of the bottom Hey from the Einayim and the MAN of the Yesod of AK. But what they had from their own emanation, namely the discernment of back to back of AVI that they had at first, this is called the anterior vessels, and these were neither cancelled nor did they descend (page 509, item 31, in the words of the ARI).
It was also explained above that after the screen was refined from phase two to phase one, the Hassadim and Gevurot fell to the Yesodot of AVI, for then the level of the ten Sefirot of ZA came out, see there. Now this level of phase one that came out in AVI is entirely front — that is, it was included in the discernment of back to back of AVI that they had at first — “and it has no posterior that descends from it,” for there is nothing in it of the coupling of Gadlut at all, that is, of the letters Badak Haya, which are the discernment of the posterior of AVI, as written there; study it there well.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:44:2
items.html: The posterior that faces the front of the female, but whose posterior is not attached to her: The meaning is that everything that did not come out of the discernment of back to back that they had at first is reckoned as the discernment of the posterior that faces the front of the female, for their posteriors are not attached to one another as they were at first, when their posteriors were attached back to back. They are therefore reckoned as the discernment of Gadlut and of an addition, from the discernments of the letters Badak Haya that descend from the Rosh of AVI. And this includes all three degrees that are above back to back, which are: back to face, face to back, and face to face. Only the first degree, that of back to back, in which their posteriors are attached to one another, both of them using one wall, is by itself reckoned as the discernment of the anterior vessels, which remained in AVI and were not cancelled. From this we learn that phase two as well, which is the level of Bina, from which the king of Gevura is drawn — this level too is reckoned as posterior, and it too was cancelled, even though in this discernment AVI stand back to face. But the Yesodot of AVI, which are phase one, are reckoned as back to back, and they do not enter into the reckoning of the cancellation of the posterior of AVI, for even before the fourth king reigned AVI were already back to back, as the ARI writes below.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:44:3
items.html: Gevura, and he drew the expansion of the five Gevurot into Ima Ila’ah: For the face of phase two is the secret of the five Gevurot, since Ima is entirely Gevurot in relation to Aba. Therefore they now stand back to face, a matter already explained above at length (page 500, the passage beginning “Above”), and from there you will know it.
